exact_map.choose: a finite rational root r of the canonical selected pair quartic and write t=r+1/u
exact_map.inverse_t: t=r+9*A/(X-3*B), with X=3*B mapping to projective t=infinity
exact_map.verification: The runner must rederive A,B,C,D over Q and assert exact equality with the locked selected short Jacobian coefficients before using any reduction.

torsion_contract.known_subgroup: The other three rational quartic roots map to three distinct rational Y=0 points, giving E[2](Q) of order 4 together with O.
torsion_contract.exactness_proof: For each selected short model, count #E(F_p) at good primes p>=5 until their gcd is 4. Good-reduction injectivity of rational torsion then bounds |E(Q)_tors| by 4, so the explicit order-4 subgroup is the full torsion group.

sieve.good_prime_exclusions: p=2,3; bad reduction; p dividing q numerator/denominator, a^2-b^2, a branch squareclass, or a denominator needed by the exact map/generator/torsion points.
sieve.necessary_local_condition: For all four parent forms U,V,A,B, F_k(T,S)/delta_k must be a square or zero mod p.
sieve.global_parameterization: Every quotient rational point is uniquely n*P+T with n in Z and T in the certified order-4 rational torsion subgroup.
sieve.closure_rule: For each fixed T, intersect allowed congruence classes for n modulo ord_p(P) across primes by generalized CRT. A parent branch closes only if the allowed integer classes are empty for every one of the four T labels.

credit: Only the 24 branches whose four torsion-translate congruence state sets are exactly empty receive parent-branch closure credit. The other 52 are unresolved; finite survival gives neither existence nor closure.
